name: Kiotome Yae
source: A client of the delivery service of whom Shoutaro is currently in charge. Yae lives together only with her husband who is a master of Japanese painting. She is a traditional and beautiful woman who is fond of the tea ceremony, flower arranging and traditional Japanese dance.
